perTurn.inputASR: 非常抱歉，您入住的酒店没有达到您的预期。
perTurn.outputTranslation: I am very sorry that the hotel you stayed at did not meet your expectations.

perTurn.inputASR: 我现在非常理解您现在的心情。
perTurn.outputTranslation: I completely understand how you are feeling right now.

perTurn.inputASR: 遇到这样的情况，确实很影响出行的心情。
perTurn.outputTranslation: Experiencing such a situation can indeed affect the mood of your trip.

perTurn.inputASR: 请您放心，我们一定会认真对待您的问题，积极为您解决这个问题的。
perTurn.outputTranslation: Please rest assured, we will take your issue seriously and actively work to resolve it for you.

perTurn.inputASR: 目前我为您准备了几个处理方案，您可以根据自己的实际需求选择。
perTurn.outputTranslation: I have prepared several solutions for you, and you can choose based on your actual needs.

perTurn.inputASR: 首先，我们可以立即联系酒店帮您更换房间，确保您能有一个更舒适的入住环境。
perTurn.outputTranslation: First, we can immediately contact the hotel to help you change rooms, ensuring you have a more comfortable stay.

perTurn.inputASR: 如果您对这家酒店已经不满意，我们也可以协调帮您免费取消订单。
perTurn.outputTranslation: If you are already dissatisfied with this hotel, we can also coordinate to help you cancel the reservation free of charge.

perTurn.inputASR: 我们会为您推荐附近同等级或者更高档次的其他酒店，确保您的行程不会受到影响。
perTurn.outputTranslation: We will recommend other hotels nearby of the same or higher class to ensure your trip is not affected.

perTurn.inputASR: 最后一个方案是我们向酒店方面提出补偿要求，比如申请房费减免或升级您的房型。
perTurn.outputTranslation: The final option is that we request compensation from the hotel, such as applying for a discount on the room rate or upgrading your room type.

perTurn.inputASR: 请您考虑一下，看看哪个方案更符合您的需求。
perTurn.outputTranslation: Please take a moment to consider which option best suits your needs.

perTurn.inputASR: 或者如果你有其他想法，也可以随时告诉我们。
perTurn.outputTranslation: Or if you have other ideas, feel free to let us know at any time.
